note: The Ford's storyboard for generated frames. A take is one generated clip (4 s or more) seen through one camera setup; a cut is a slice of a take (or of code) placed on the score. Times are piece seconds (ford_blocking.js TIME, at(bar, beat)). Each take: a first key drawn from its previs frame (keys/), then a video model run with the key as its look, the previs (previs3d/) as @Video1 for blocking and camera, and a prompt with action and reaction to the second. The engine owns the edit, camera pushes, shake, hit-stop, effects, the palette snap and the rewind.
style: Hand-drawn fantasy illustration in the manner of a Renaissance sketchbook: fine sepia ink linework inside the figures, one confident thicker contour around each silhouette, pale transparent watercolour, a cool bone-grey palette under an overcast sky. The Warden and the Empire's soldiers are painted dense iron-black and crimson; Edric lighter, like an unfinished sketch. 2D hand-drawn anime animation. No text, no logo, no border, no blood.

edric.text: Edric: a young swordsman, shaggy DARK CHESTNUT-BROWN hair (not red, not auburn), square jaw, heavy straight brows, deep-set tired eyes, a nose broken once, a deep teal cloak, one steel pauldron, worn leather, a plain longsword.

warden.text: the Warden: an imperial spearman, a closed black iron helm with a narrow eye slit, dark iron armour, a crimson tabard, a long wooden spear (2.4 m) with an iron head.

rank.text: the Empire's rank: soldiers in black helms and crimson, long spears upright, in step.

keyLegend: The teal mannequin is Edric; the red ones are the Empire (the largest red one, nearest, is the Warden). Where a figure stands in the river, its legs go under the water and disappear below the surface, with a ring of ripples and a little broken white foam where each leg meets the water, and its reflection lies on the water under it. Where a figure stands on the bank, its boots press into the mud and it casts a soft shadow. Rain.
keyPlace: The place is the ford of the last reference image: a shallow, slow river between low banks, reeds, grey ridges, an overcast sky.
physics: every foot that carries weight stays planted where it stands; legs in the river go under the surface and push ripples and white foam; nothing floats or glides; every blow moves the one who takes it.

takes.name: the upstream wide
action: Far off on the left bank, Edric breaks into a run toward the river; the Empire's rank on the far bank turns as one and steps down toward the water.
Edric splashes into the shallows; on the far bank the rank halts in unison at the water's edge, spears upright.
Edric wades on through the current, small in the wide; the river runs toward us; rain.
takes.camera: Take the camera from @Video1: a slow crane down that settles into a wide shot looking up the river; the river comes toward the lens between low banks and distant grey ridges.

takes.name: the Warden steps in
action: The Warden walks down the bank toward the water, the rank in step behind him.
His iron boot steps into the shallows: a ring of ripples runs out from it; the rank's boots stamp into the edge in unison behind him.
He wades two steps out and plants his feet in the shallows, knee-deep; the rank stands at the water's edge.
takes.camera: Low at the water, as in @Video1: the lens just above the surface, the boots large in frame. Camera locked.

takes.name: the spear levels
action: The Warden stands knee-deep, the spear carried upright; his weight sinks a little (anticipation).
He snaps the spear down into both hands: in one sharp movement the point drops forward and levels straight at the lens.
He holds the guard, perfectly still; the crimson tabard settles; rain runs off the helm; the point stays on the lens.
takes.camera: Low and in front of him, as in @Video1, looking up at the guard, the point foreshortened toward the lens. Camera locked.

takes.name: Edric runs the ford
action: Edric runs through knee-deep water from left to right, high knees, each foot plunging into the river with a splash; his legs disappear under the surface and drive through it; the cloak streams back.
He keeps running toward the spearman ahead (off screen right), the sword held low and back.
takes.camera: A tracking profile shot as in @Video1: the camera moves with him, reeds and stones near the lens slide past fast, the far bank slides slowly. The feet stay planted in the riverbed on each step: no gliding.

takes.name: the thrust (over the shoulder)
action: Over the Warden's shoulder: Edric charges toward us through the water, growing larger.
Edric reads the Warden sinking and drops low; the Warden snaps the spear forward.
The spear reaches full length: its point shoots away from us and passes just over Edric's head as he drops into the water.
Edric slides through the water under the spear, throwing up a wall of spray; the Warden pulls the spear back.
takes.camera: Over the Warden's right shoulder as in @Video1: his helm and shoulder dark in the foreground, Edric in the river beyond. Camera locked.

takes.name: the slide and the spray
action: Edric charges at the Warden through the water.
He drops and slides on his hip under a thrusting spear; a tall sheet of white spray erupts in front of him; the spear's point passes through the spray.
The spray hangs and falls; a shape coils inside it.
Edric bursts up out of the spray right in front of the Warden and strikes the spear's shaft: sparks.
They are locked together, sword against shaft, straining.
takes.camera: Wide and low, as in @Video1, the water near the lens. Camera locked.

takes.name: the master: clash to fall
action: Edric surges up inside the spear's reach and strikes the wooden shaft: a burst of sparks; the Warden takes it on the shaft and is rocked back half a step, his back foot sliding through the water.
The bind: sword and shaft crossed at one point between them. Edric drives forward with his legs; the Warden holds, then gives ground half a step. Both strain; their arms shake.
The Warden's helm tilts very slightly: he has decided.
He steps back and draws the shaft off the blade, lifting it. With nothing to push against, Edric pitches forward and his front foot lands on a flat wet stone.
The stone throws his foot forward: he drops low onto his back foot, arms flung up and back for balance, his chest open.
The Warden raises the spear high over his head.
He brings the iron head down across Edric's chest in one sweeping stroke.
The blow drives Edric over backwards: he falls onto his back into the river, a big splash; the Warden stands over him.
takes.camera: Locked off at the height and angle of @Video1, a medium two-shot.

takes.name: the fall (reverse, low)
action: From the far side: Edric and the Warden locked in the bind.
The Warden steps back and lifts the shaft away; Edric pitches forward onto a wet stone and his foot shoots out from under him; he drops low.
The Warden's spear comes down across Edric's chest.
Edric goes over backwards and lands on his back in the river: a big splash that rises and falls.
He lies in the shallow water, the surface settling round him in rings; rain; the Warden stands over him, the spear held low.
takes.camera: Low at the water from the far side, as in @Video1. Camera locked.

takes.name: the helm decides
action: Extreme close-up of the black helm's eye slit in the rain; behind the slit, an eye fixed on something below. Still.
The helm tilts down very slightly; the eye narrows.
Held. Rain streams down the iron.

takes.name: Edric's face, struck
action: Close-up of Edric's face: the blow lands; his head snaps back.
In slow motion: his eyes widen in shock, his hair lifts, drops of river water hang in the air around his face and drift.
